description.value: Donair Cafe is a fast-food spot in Sardis, Chilliwack, specializing in donairs — a Maritime-style spiced beef dish served in flatbread that is popular across Western Canada. Located in the Fraser Valley, it sits along cycling routes connecting Chilliwack's communities. As a quick-service eatery, it would offer a calorie-dense, inexpensive stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.

address.value: 7670 Vedder Rd #105, Chilliwack, BC V2R 4G9, Canada
